name: aec-model-bridge
description: Revit and BIM tools for Copilot agent mode and other MCP clients in VS Code. Sets up the MCP server with zero config.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension starts a local MCP server that can act on Revit models. It only runs in trusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Talk to a running Revit through the AEC Model Bridge add-in.
Use simulated data. Works without Revit.
aecModelBridge.mode.description: Bridge mode needs Revit with the add-in running. Mock mode works without Revit.

aecModelBridge.revitYear.description: Revit year to connect to. Leave on auto to use whichever Revit is running.

aecModelBridge.workspaceDir.description: Folder the server may read and write (exports, reports, scripts). Empty uses the first folder open in VS Code, or your Documents folder.

enumDescriptions: Every change to the model needs your explicit approval. Recommended.
Approvals are skipped. The AI can change the model without asking.
aecModelBridge.approvalMode.markdownDescription: **Keep this on `required`.** With `auto`, the approval gate is switched off and an AI agent can change or delete things in your Revit model without asking first.

aecModelBridge.statusRefreshSeconds.description: How often the status bar checks whether Revit is reachable.
